reuse.why: The change shares exclusion logic across all month-wide actions and reuses tag parsing, spreadsheet access, budget writes, batching and undo wrappers.

duplication.why: Most category-selection duplication is removed, although income eligibility remains repeated and eligibility metadata is assembled in two queries.

placement.why: Budget policy stays in the server budget actions module, with method registration and undo handling following the existing application layer.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, focused tests and release documentation.

maintainability.why: The shared predicate and options type make future exclusion changes straightforward, with minor remaining duplication in eligibility checks and metadata queries.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions call isSkippedByMonthAction, and the new action uses the existing budget mutation infrastructure.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining income checks and query metadata projections are direct repetitions rather than renamed or reshaped copies.

abstraction_drift.where: isSkippedByMonthAction gains the includeHiddenCategories flag and its hidden-exclusion override condition; this requested variation is shared by every month-wide caller.
